Dans un contexte de forte croissance, nous renforçons notre support de la Direction Générale Votre rô le : Assurer un support de haut niveau à la Direction Générale et coordonne les services généraux pour offrir un cadre de travail performant et sécurisé. Ce poste stratégique combine en effet les responsabilités d'assistanat exécutif et de gestion des opérations internes. Il vise à garantir l'efficacité des dirigeants tout en assurant un environnement de travail optimal pour l'ensemble des équipes. Vos miss ions : Executive Assistant Gestion de l’agenda et des réunions Organiser et coordonner les rendez-vous, réunions et déplacements professionnels des dirigeants Préparer les dossiers pour les réunions (ordres du jour, compte rendu, documents nécessaires) notamment lors des Comités de Direction, et autres réunions avec le Board Assurer le suivi des décisions prises lors des réunions (suivi des actions) Organisation des déplacements Planifier et organiser les déplacements professionnels (réservations de transport, hébergement, itinéraires) des Dirigeants et autres collaborateurs du siège Organiser les réunions au siège avec tous membres du Board (Transferts, Hotels, logistique) Préparer les itinéraires et gérer les imprévus pendant les déplacements Communication interne, gestion de projets et évènementiel : Assure la gestion de projets relatifs à la direction générale Organiser les séminaires, réunions stratégiques et événements internes. Assurer la communication et la circulation de l’information entre la Direction Générale et les interlocuteurs internes et externes. Gérer les communications écrites et orales de la Direction Générale. Gérer les appels téléphoniques, emails et courriers, en priorisant les demandes Agir comme intermédiaire entre les dirigeants et les interlocuteurs internes et externes Rédiger des courriers, notes de synthèse et autres documents professionnels au nom de la direction Project Manager Coordination et gestion des locaux : Gérer l’accueil des locaux Veiller à l’entretien des locaux, à l’aménagement des espaces de travail et de vie et à la gestion des déménagements, si nécessaire Gérer les espaces de travail (salles de réunion, fournitures, clef) et de vie (cafétéria, machine à café) Gérer le contrôle d’accès aux locaux (création et restitution badges d’accès) Accueillir, coordonner et gérer les entreprises extérieures Garantir la sécurité des locaux (mise en conformité, gestion des extincteurs, sorties de secours...) et suivi des actions (mise à jour du DUERP, en collaboration avec le département RH, mise aux normes des locaux…) Rédige les procédures nécessaires au fonctionnement des locaux Gestion administrative : Assurer le suivi administratif général (courrier, documents légaux, archivage, contrats fournisseurs). Gérer les fournitures de bureau et le matériel nécessaire au bon fonctionnement du bureau. Gérer les contrats et les relations avec les prestataires (fournisseurs, maintenance, téléphonie fixe ...). Optimiser les coûts de fonctionnement des services généraux Organisation et coordination des événements : Organiser des événements internes et externes (réunions, séminaires, conférences, événements d’entreprise) en lien avec le service RH et les services internes concernés. S'occuper de la logistique pour les événements : réservation de lieux, coordination des prestataires, gestion des invitations. Références des partenaires extérieurs pour les différentes prestations (prestataires ESAT : plateaux-repas, buffet…) Communication au sein des bureaux Coordonne en partenariat avec les responsables de département les actions de communication relative aux bureaux auprès des salariés (siège et terrain) Profil recherché : Formation Bac +2/3 : BTS, DUT ou licence en assistanat de direction/manager, gestion administrative et commerciale, gestion PME-PMI Une expérience confirmée en assistanat exécutif ou assistanat de direction dans l’industrie pharmaceutique est requise Maitrise de l’anglais professionnel Capacité à travailler en équipe et à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés. Sens des priorisations, autonomie, rigueur, sens de l’organisation Maîtrise des outils bureautiques Ce que nous offrons : Un rôle clé et transversal. Un laboratoire dynamique avec un portefeuille en pleine croissance. Une évolution progressive vers une polyvalence sur d’autres missions. Des projets variés tout au long de l’année. Process d'entretien 1er contact téléphonique avec notre Talent acquisition : Camille 2ème contact visio (30min) avec Camille 3ème contact avec la Directrice des Ressources Humaines 4ème contact avec la Directrice Générale Proposition d'embauche

review_candidates.title: ERP MÜDÜRÜ
review_candidates.description: ERP MÜDÜRÜ Şirket Hakkında Efor Holding, köklü ticari birikimini yenilikçi vizyonuyla birleştirerek Türkiye’nin farklı sektörlerinde sürdürülebilir değer üreten güçlü bir holding yapısıdır. Çay, kömür, gübre, hububat, enerji, sigorta, filo yönetimi ve gayrimenkul yatırım alanlarında faaliyet gösteren grup şirketleriyle; kalite, güven, operasyonel mükemmeliyet ve sürdürülebilir büyüme ilkeleri doğrultusunda ülke ekonomisine katkı sağlamaktadır. Efor Holding bünyesinde, grup şirketlerimizin ERP altyapısının etkin şekilde yönetilmesi, süreçlerin dijitalleştirilmesi ve sürekli geliştirilmesinden sorumlu olacak ERP Müdürü arıyoruz. Nasıl Bir Takım Arkadaşı Arıyoruz? Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Endüstri Mühendisliği, Yönetim Bilişim Sistemleri (YBS) veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, ERP sistemleri alanında en az 7 yıl, CANIAS ERP alanında en az 5 yıl deneyimli, CANIAS ERP'nin kurulum, yapılandırma, geliştirme, entegrasyon, bakım ve kullanıcı yönetimi süreçlerinde deneyimli, CANIAS ERP projelerinde analiz, tasarım, test, canlıya geçiş ve proje sonrası destek süreçlerini yönetmiş, Finans, muhasebe, satın alma, satış, stok, üretim, lojistik ve insan kaynakları gibi farklı iş süreçlerinin CANIAS ERP üzerindeki işleyişine hâkim, İş birimlerinin ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek CANIAS ERP üzerinde çözüm üretebilen, İş analizi, süreç tasarımı, süreç iyileştirme ve proje yönetimi konularında deneyimli, CANIAS ERP ile diğer uygulamalar arasında entegrasyon, veri aktarımı ve veri yönetimi süreçlerine hâkim, CANIAS ERP performansı, veri kalitesi, yetkilendirme, erişim güvenliği ve kullanıcı yönetimi konularında deneyimli, Raporlama, dashboard ve yönetim bilgi sistemleri çözümlerinin geliştirilmesine liderlik edebilen, Teknik ekipler ile iş birimleri arasında koordinasyonu sağlayabilecek güçlü iletişim becerilerine sahip, Ekip yönetimi ve liderlik deneyimi bulunan, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve sonuç odaklı çalışma yetkinliklerine sahip, İyi derecede İngilizce bilen, Tercihen farklı sektörlerde faaliyet gösteren şirketlerde CANIAS ERP dönüşüm/proje deneyimi bulunan. Takım Arkadaşımızdan Neler Bekliyoruz? Grup şirketlerinin CANIAS ERP sisteminin uçtan uca yönetimini ve sürekli geliştirilmesini sağlamak, Kullanıcı taleplerini analiz ederek önceliklendirmek ve çözüm süreçlerini yönetmek, İş birimleriyle birlikte mevcut süreçleri analiz ederek ERP üzerinde süreç iyileştirme ve standardizasyon projeleri geliştirmek, CANIAS ERP'nin yapılandırma ve özelleştirme süreçlerini yönetmek, Yeni modül, fonksiyon ve uygulamaların devreye alınmasına liderlik etmek, CANIAS ERP projelerinde analiz, planlama, test, kullanıcı kabul ve canlıya geçiş süreçlerini yönetmek, CANIAS ERP ile banka, e-ticaret, CRM, BI, bordro, e-fatura/e-arşiv ve diğer kurumsal uygulamalar arasındaki entegrasyon süreçlerini yönetmek, Veri kalitesi, veri güvenliği, yetkilendirme ve erişim kontrollerinin etkin şekilde uygulanmasını sağlamak, CANIAS ERP veri tabanı ve uygulama performansını takip etmek; gerekli iyileştirmeleri planlamak, Yönetim raporlaması ve dashboard ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek ilgili çözümlerin geliştirilmesini sağlamak, Anahtar kullanıcı (key user) yapısını oluşturmak ve yönetmek, CANIAS ERP kullanıcı eğitimlerini planlamak, eğitim içeriklerini ve dokümantasyonunu hazırlamak, güncelleme, bakım ve versiyon geçişlerini planlamak ve yönetmek, CANIAS ERP hizmet sağlayıcıları ve dış kaynak ekipleriyle ilişkileri yönetmek, CANIAS ERP ile ilgili proje, bakım, lisans ve geliştirme bütçelerini takip etmek, Üst yönetime düzenli olarak proje ilerleme, sistem performansı, riskler ve iyileştirme fırsatları hakkında raporlama yapmak, Grup şirketleri arasında CANIAS ERP süreçlerinin mümkün olduğunca standardize edilmesine ve dijital dönüşüm hedeflerinin gerçekleştirilmesine liderlik etmek.

review_candidates.description: Values & Innovation At Under Armour, we are committed to empowering those who strive for more, and the company's values - Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes and Stand for Equality - serve as both a roadmap for our teams and the qualities expected of every teammate. If you are a current Under Armour teammate, apply to this position on the Internal Career Site Here. This leader sets the global payroll strategy, elevates operational excellence, and drives modernization of payroll platforms, data flow, and processes. They partner closely with HR, Finance, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Technology, and regional leadership teams to build a scalable, compliant, digital-first payroll ecosystem. This leader owns payroll governance, vendor strategy, process optimization, analytics, risk management, and payroll experience across all regions. Your Impact Leadership & Strategy Develop and execute a global payroll strategy aligned with UA’s people, financial, and operational priorities. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing global payroll organization with clear goals, capabilities, and succession planning. Champion a culture of data stewardship, operational discipline, and continuous improvement. Global Payroll Operations Oversee accurate, compliant, and timely payroll delivery for all teammates across 25+ countries, ensuring consistency in global standards. Ensure compliance with all global, federal, state, and local payroll, tax, and wage regulations. Manage payroll governance, including global SOX controls, audits, quarterly certifications, and risk remediation. Technology, Data & Process Modernization Own payroll and timekeeping platforms, partnering on system roadmap and integration strategy (e.g., ADP, Globalview, SuccessFactors EC, Workforce Management, Celergo). Align Payroll and Accounting SOX controls, ensuring end‑to‑end documentation across system interfaces, GL posting, and journal approval workflows. Collaborate with Accounting on process improvements, automation opportunities, and standardization of global financial processes tied to compensation. Vendor, Stakeholder & Cross‑Functional Partnership Lead strategic management of global and regional payroll vendors, contracts, and service levels. review_candidates.title: Customer Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview Silvus is seeking a Customer Operations Manager who will report to the International Customer Operations Lead. The successful individual in this role will serve as the primary post-sales operational liaison between our key customers and Silvus manufacturing organization and internal associated departments. The mission is to manage purchase orders, production schedules, delivery coordination to ensure components are delivered on time and integrated successfully into the customer’s long-term production roadmap. This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location. The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion Job Description Key Responsibilities Customer Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for customer post sale, managing day-to-day operational needs and escalations. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to report on delivery performance, quality metrics, and roadmap alignment. Demand Planning & Forecast Integration: Work directly with customer demand planners to ingest production forecasts. Translate these into actionable data for our internal manufacturing and supply chain teams to prevent stockouts or overages. Delivery Management: Track and manage open purchase orders to ensure on-time delivery commitments are met, partnering with manufacturing and logistics to resolve delays. Technical Advocacy & Issue Resolution: Identify technical hurdles or integration challenges the customer is facing. Partner with Engineering to resolve issues and manage the formal escalation process for any hardware defects or shipping delays. Lifecycle Management: Monitor component performance in the field. Manage the communication of End-of-Life (EOL) notices and transition customers to next-generation components. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the "Voice of the Customer" internally, providing feedback to Product Development to influence the design of future components or products. RMA Management: Managing the Return Merchandise Authorization process - making sure that if a part fails, the customer gets a replacement immediately and your engineering team gets the "dead" part back for analysis. Regional Expertise: Navigate the specific logistical, legal, and contractual complexities unique to key countries like Germany and the Ukrainian theater. Perform other related duties of which the above are representative. Basic Requirements A self-motivated professional who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and takes full ownership of multitasking and shifting priorities. Languages: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills in English and either German or Ukrainian. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field. Experience: 5+ years in a post-sales, account management, or technical project management role, preferably within the Defense, Aerospace, Robotics, or Semiconductor industries. Analytical Prowess: Ability to analyze complex spreadsheets and production schedules to find discrepancies between demand and supply. Communication: Demonstrated ability to "translate" between a customer's high-level business needs and a factory's granular production constraints. Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the drone ecosystem (UAV regulations, flight controllers, propulsion systems) is a significant plus. Experience managing military or defense-sector clients is considered a significant asset. Clearance: All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check. Travel Requirements 10-25% Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan No EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
